record.original_question: Characterize which classical Goppa codes, extended or not, are cyclic.

evidence.quote: the problem of the characterization of classi￾cal Goppa codes (extended or not) which are cyclic remains open.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let q be a prime power, m a positive integer, and let F = GF(q^m) be the finite field with q^m elements. Let L = (α_1, …, α_n) be a tuple of distinct elements of F (the support) and let g(x) ∈ F[x] be a polynomial (the Goppa polynomial) such that g(α_i) ≠ 0 for all i. The classical Goppa code Γ(L, g) is the GF(q)-linear code of length n consisting of all vectors (c_1, …, c_n) ∈ GF(q)^n satisfying

    Σ_{i=1}^{n} c_i / (x − α_i) ≡ 0  (mod g(x))

in F[x]/(g(x)). The extended Goppa code is obtained from Γ(L, g) by appending an overall parity-check coordinate.

A linear code C ⊆ GF(q)^N is called cyclic if it is invariant under the cyclic shift (c_1, c_2, …, c_N) ↦ (c_N, c_1, …, c_{N−1}) (after a suitable ordering of the coordinates).

Problem: Give a complete characterization of those triples (q, L, g) for which the classical Goppa code Γ(L, g) is (equivalent to) a cyclic code, and, separately, of those triples for which the extended classical Goppa code is (equivalent to) a cyclic code.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of fully characterizing which classical Goppa codes (extended or not) are cyclic remains open. Numerous works (Berlekamp–Moreno, Tzeng–Zimmermann, Berger, and more recent papers including a 2024 preprint on generator polynomials of cyclic expurgated or extended Goppa codes) provide sufficient conditions and new families of cyclic (extended) Goppa codes, but no complete characterization has been established.

status_evidence.title: Which extended Goppa codes are cyclic?
status_evidence.snippet: Conditions for a classical Goppa code to have a cyclic extension, producing known and new families.
status_evidence.claim: Partial sufficient conditions are known, but not a full characterization.

status_evidence.title: Generator polynomials of cyclic expurgated or extended Goppa codes
status_evidence.snippet: Determines generator polynomials of cyclic expurgated or extended Goppa codes under prescribed PGL-induced permutations.
status_evidence.claim: Recent (2024) work continues to investigate, indicating the general characterization is still not complete.

status_evidence.title: A new subclass of cyclic Goppa codes
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs a new subclass of cyclic Goppa codes.
status_evidence.claim: New subclasses continue to be discovered, consistent with the problem remaining open.
